newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Senate may vote oil bill next Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Senate may vote oil bill next Tuesday.

text.p: The Brazilian Senate Wednesday gave a bill regulating the opening up of the petroleum sector priority treatment, paving the way for a floor vote next Tuesday, a Congress official said.
The official said senators voted 52 votes for and 11 against to speed up the passage of the bill, which was approved by the Senate Economic Affairs Committee Tuesday evening.
The earliest possible date for a full vote on the Senate floor is next Tuesday, she added.
Brazil's Congress approved in 1995 the break-up of state oil firm Petrobras' monopoly but has still to pass the enabling legislation.
The oil bill sets down rules for private sector investment in the oil and gas sector.
It also establishes a regulator for the industry.
